verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official MCP server (docs.cubic.dev/ide/mcp-server) allowing coding agents to read review findings/codebase context, request PR reviews, and even manage subscription/seats via MCP client; runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live and properly OAuth-gated. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on report of connecting an agent to the MCP server and confirming functionality beyond auth handshake.
